# delivery-readiness

Adopted I10 product/UI summary. Aggregate actual controlled specialized evidence
with current input hashes, checker identity, scope and freshness. Index canonical
requirements, stories, page-plan, selected design, technical/source/rule registers
and development-handoff; decisions and pending items are explicit. Any missing,
failed, unverified or stale applicable conclusion blocks product/UI readiness.

Derived `product-ui-ready` never changes workflow stage completion. Development
admission also requires reception/technical review bound to current package,
applicable I10 completion and existing I11/I12/I13/PRD/TDD dependencies. Admission
and completion both recheck current product hashes, tolerating implementation-only
revision drift. Unknown/expired quality evidence is not filtered as a legacy resume.
Errors: DELIVERY_GATE_NOT_READY, DELIVERY_BLOCKER_OPEN,
DELIVERY_PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE, DEVELOPMENT_ENTRY_NOT_READY.
